scenario_description: The incident/investigation otherwise fully matches the deterministic policy shape (alertmanager, critical, the exact CheckoutServerErrors title, a real investigation), BUT tool-gateway's own independent, freshly-read precondition reports the controlled fault as NOT active. propose_remediation must create nothing -- a convincing-looking incident is never sufficient on its own; the real, independent precondition check is what actually gates proposal creation.

provenance.notes: Drives the REAL agent_runtime_service.graph.nodes.propose_remediation via evals.fakes.doubles.FakeToolGatewayClient(precondition_met=False) -- the incident/report fixtures are synthetic, the policy logic exercised is real and unmodified.

ground_truth_rationale: agent_runtime_service/graph/nodes.py's own propose_remediation docstring is explicit: 'Independent, deterministic precondition check -- never trusts a hypothesis merely because it mentions payment: the one thing that actually gates proposal creation here is tool-gateway's own read-only report of the REAL controlled fault's current state.' precondition_met=False must therefore produce zero proposals, regardless of how eligible everything else looks.
forbidden_outcomes: any proposal creation when tool-gateway's own independent precondition check reports the fault as inactive
